flowchart TB

 USER[User]

 subgraph FRONTEND[\"Frontend\"]
 PAGES[Pages and UI Components]
 CLIENT[API Client]

 PAGES --> CLIENT
 end

 subgraph BACKEND[\"Backend - Modular Monolith\"]

 API[API Layer]

 subgraph APPLICATION[\"Application Modules\"]
 CHAT[Chat Module]
 SESSION[User and Session Module]
 LLMINT[LLM Integration Module]
 end

 subgraph SHARED[\"Shared Core\"]
 CONFIG[Configuration]
 COMMON[Common Types and Exceptions]
 end

 subgraph PORTS[\"Ports / Interfaces\"]
 DBPORT[Persistence Port]
 LLMPORT[LLM Provider Port]
 end

 API --> CHAT
 API --> SESSION

 CHAT --> LLMINT

 CHAT --> DBPORT
 SESSION --> DBPORT
 LLMINT --> LLMPORT

 CHAT -.-> COMMON
 SESSION -.-> COMMON
 LLMINT -.-> CONFIG
 end

 subgraph INFRASTRUCTURE[\"Infrastructure Adapters\"]
 DBADAPTER[Persistence Adapter]
 LLMADAPTER[LLM Adapter]
 end

 subgraph DATA[\"Data Layer\"]
 DB[(Database)]
 end

 subgraph PROVIDERS[\"LLM Providers\"]
 LOCAL[Local LLM]
 EXTERNAL[External LLM API]
 end

 USER --> PAGES

 CLIENT -->|HTTPS / REST / JSON| API

 DBPORT --> DBADAPTER
 DBADAPTER --> DB

 LLMPORT --> LLMADAPTER
 LLMADAPTER --> LOCAL
 LLMADAPTER --> EXTERNAL",
